<!--
Copy this file to vX.Y.Z.md (matching the tag you're about to push) and fill
it in before tagging. The release workflow reads that file and refuses to
publish if it's missing.

This content becomes the ONLY thing shown in the app's own update banner and
changelog view, so keep it to actual changes: features, improvements, bug
fixes. No install instructions, no Discord links, no download links. The
surrounding release template already covers all of that on GitHub, and a
user reading this inside the app already has it installed and running.

Shape of a highlight: heading, one line saying why anyone cares, then bullets
for the specifics. Don't write a paragraph per change, and don't pad the
bullets. Three honest ones beat five with filler.

Emoji: one per #### heading, and nowhere else. Never on a bullet. A row of
emoji-headed bullets reads as generated rather than written.

Delete whichever section doesn't apply. Delete this comment block too.
-->

### Highlights

#### 🚀 Feature or improvement title
One line on why someone would care.

- The specific thing that changed.
- Another specific thing.

#### ✨ Another highlight
...

### Bug Fixes

- Short, specific description of what was broken and now isn't.
- One line per fix; skip this section entirely if there are none.
